modules.title: Introduction to Second Republic and Return to Democracy
modules.html:
The Second Republic (1979-1983) and the transition to democracy in 1999. This section covers introduction to second republic and return to democracy.

Key points

  • The 'Second Republic' (1979-1983) was led by President _____. — Shehu Shagari.
  • Nigeria became a Republic in: — 1963.
  • Fourth Republic started: — 1999.
  • The First Executive President of Nigeria (Second Republic) was... — Shehu Shagari.
  • The Fourth Republic began in: — 1999.

Worked examples

Q: The 'Second Republic' (1979-1983) was led by President _____.
A: Shehu Shagari — Alhaji Shehu Shagari was the first executive President of Nigeria under the NPN.

Q: Nigeria became a Republic in:
A: 1963 — Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: 1963.

quiz.q: The 1929 Aba Women’s Riot was primarily caused by the _____.
options: introduction of direct taxation on women
quiz.solution: The riot (Ogu Umunwanyi) was a protest by Igbo women against the rumor that the colonial government intended to tax women.

quiz.q: The 'Warrant Chief' system was introduced by the British in _____.
quiz.solution: Since the Igbo had an acephalous (decentralized) society, the British created 'Warrant Chiefs' to facilitate indirect rule, which led to significant local resentment.

quiz.q: The Lyttleton Constitution of 1954 is significant because it _____.
options: formally established a federal system of government
quiz.solution: The Lyttleton Constitution is regarded as the 'Federal Constitution' because it gave substantial autonomy to the regions and created a federal structure.

quiz.q: The 'Willink Commission' of 1957 was set up to _____.
options: investigate the cause of the Aba riot
address the fears of minority groups in Nigeria
quiz.solution: The commission concluded that while minorities had genuine fears of domination by the majority tribes, new states should not be created before independence.

quiz.q: The head of the government in the 1963 Constitution was the _____.
quiz.solution: Although Nigeria became a republic, it retained the Westminster system where the President (Azikiwe) was a ceremonial head and the PM (Balewa) held executive power.

quiz.q: The legendary founder of the Hausa states according to oral tradition is _____.
quiz.solution: The Bayajidda legend describes a hero from Baghdad who killed a snake in Daura and fathered the founders of the Hausa Bakwai.

quiz.q: The Lyttleton Constitution of 1954 is significant because it formally established _____.
quiz.solution: It shared powers between the center and the regions and provided for regional autonomy.

quiz.q: The 'Macpherson Constitution' of 1951 was criticized for being a _____ constitution.
quiz.solution: It was called a compromise because it attempted to balance the centralist and regionalist demands of Nigerian politicians.

quiz.q: The Aba Women's Riot of 1929 was caused by:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Taxation of women.

quiz.q: The June 12, 1993 presidential election was believed to be won by:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: M.K.O. Abiola.

quiz.q: Samory Toure was a resistance leader in:

quiz.q: The 1979 Constitution established the:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Executive Presidential System.

quiz.q: Jaja of Opobo was a merchant prince in:

quiz.q: Samuel Ajayi Crowther was the first:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: African Bishop.

quiz.q: Herbert Macaulay is regarded as:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Father of Nigerian Nationalism.

quiz.q: Ken Saro-Wiwa was an activist from:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Ogoni.

quiz.q: Nok Culture is associated with:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Terracotta.

quiz.q: Aba Women's Riot year:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: 1929.

quiz.q: OAU (AU) founded in:

quiz.q: Nelson Mandela was imprisoned for:

quiz.q: The British explorer who discovered the mouth of the River Niger in 1830 was...

options: It gave too much money to the North
It was drafted without consulting Nigerians
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: It was drafted without consulting Nigerians.

quiz.solution: Past question (WAEC 2025). Correct answer: Kumbi Saleh.
